name: fxf_s434_decision
doc: Stands in for saves/field_re/s434_decision_lake.state, its own provenance from the recipe-made Truce market: the ROM's own loader (--teleport 434 8 8 0, method jmp, 240 frames) puts Crono in the Tent of Horrors (loc 1B2) at tile (8,8) facing up, one step below Bekkler's tile (storyline 3, 600 G). USED since 2026-10-22 (tools/fixtures/rest.json makes saves/field_re/s434_decision*; the owner's capture is retired): lockstep-decision-box-s434-clean grades the decision box's bytes on it with tools/textbox_bytes_cmp.py s434 under the rule, 0 of 869 frames differ. Before that it was not used: the in-process lockstep diverged on it at f582 (obj10's 4-frame idle loop one frame earlier against obj11's dialogue end than in the capture).
